unit.method: the target topology with a blank garage, a callout at each mouth (two at the garage, read with different confidence), a dashed overhead line; the wall bands, the dimension chains and the callouts each shuffled eight seeded ways, and all three together eight more; every separator, interval, role, recess, wide-opening decision and cell class must be byte-identical

tests.test: eight shuffles of the bands change nothing

tests.suite: 005N §31 — order invariance of the compound reading
tests.test: eight shuffles of the chains change nothing

tests.suite: 005N §31 — order invariance of the compound reading
tests.test: eight shuffles of the callouts change nothing

tests.suite: 005N §31 — order invariance of the compound reading

orientation: every major §21 family and every council fixture asserts the same reading in five orientations (synthetic-compound-facades.json)
pocketOrder: the pocket test reads every own pocket and the decided openings before any decision is applied (council A2, round 2 R3); M11 reverts that and is killed by the two-mouths fixture
derivedOrder: grid lines, separator candidates and intervals are derived in coordinate order from the shuffled inputs, never enumerated in an input order; the separator bound never reads part of a gap (council D3)

replay.method: the 10 development rows with compound spans replayed a second time at the same commit: model hash (or failure code) and the full plan digest compared
